notes: Tiny fixture files and malformed ZIPs were temporary and are not included in delivery.
The import lock binds the intended transfer set against accidental overlay/parity changes; it is not a cryptographic signature or a guarantee against an actor editing both code and lock.
The freeze failure control intentionally stops at a missing test. Its expected nonzero exit, marker removal and lack of cache files are targeted observations, not a complete successful freeze.
The 007 protocol pass binds the approved 296-entry ZIP and preserved model bytes; it does not upgrade archived rendering or geometry claims and does not cover later webpage overlay edits.
